claim: *Service-flow model.* A declared graph of which service may reach which. The public web tier is the only node facing the outside; an absent edge means the relationship is not permitted by the model, and enforcement is separate.

topology.description: Declared permitted service relationships; absence does not declare a relation.

required_terms: Each arrow declares a permitted relationship.
bw_encoding: Black outlines and arrows; white nodes; sparse 3–7% gray groups. Every non-solid relation is locally labeled; no distinction depends on color.
redesign: Native semantic redraw; colors replaced by labeled relations and line conventions.
alt: The declared service graph connects Internet to web; web to worker, document editor and other; worker to generation, render and OCR. Every directed edge is a declared permitted relationship. An absent edge declares no relationship. The candidate uses black lines, white backgrounds and sparse gray; meaning does not depend on color.
